question_en: What was agreed on BWP switching?
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'BWP' AND a.content CONTAINS 'switch' RETURN m.meetingNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10
original_ordering: meetingNumberInt DESC only; no secondary tie is introduced
